newsitem.title: POLAND: Kety buys 48 pct of metal products maker.
newsitem.headline: Kety buys 48 pct of metal products maker.

text.p: Polish aluminium plant Kety SA has signed a contract to buy a 47.62-percent stake in metal products maker Zaklady Elementow Wykonczenia Budownictwa Metalplast - Bielsko SA, Kety said in a statement on Tuesday.
Kety said it took up 9.52 percent of the company's shares immediately after the signing and that the anti-monopoly office would have to approve its taking of the remaining 38.1 percent.
It said Kety would be able to raise its stake after three years and that Metalplast was expected to net 6.5 million zlotys this year on sales of 60 million zlotys. @
The statement gave no further details and no one at Kety was immediately available for comment.
